name: LABORATORY JAW CRUSHER
desc: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS INNO-JC-J200E Laboratory Jaw Crusher is an indispensable primary crushing unit used in geology, mining, and metallurgy laboratories. It is engineered to forcefully and quickly break down hard, brittle rocks, ores, ceramics, cement, and glass into smaller, manageable pieces for further analytical preparation.
features: Zero point adjustment feature for precise gap setting
Models available with final fineness < 2mm and < 0.5mm
Removable anti-splash feed hopper for easy sample loading
Powerful industrial drive with in-built overload protection
Choice of jaw plates: Manganese steel, Stainless steel, Tungsten carbide, Zirconium oxide

specifications.Jaw Plate Material Options: Manganese steel, Stainless steel, Tungsten carbide, Zirconium oxide
specifications.Target Applications: Geology, Mining, Metallurgy, Cement, and Coal analysis
